caseName: Rixey ex rel. Rixey v. Cox
caseNameFull: C. J. Rixey, an Insane Person, by C. J. Rixey, Jr. v. Robert H. Cox, Sergeant of the City of Alexandria, Va.
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Virginia.
attorneys: Mr. John L. Jeffries and Mr. Jas. B. Catón for the appellant. Mr. J. Garland Pollard and Mr. Christopher B. Garnett for the appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of juris- • diction upon the authority of. (1) Farrell v. O'Brien, 199 *688U. S. 89, 100; David Kaufman & Sons Co. v. Smith, 216 U. S. 610; Cassidy v. Colorado, 223 U. S. 707; (2) In re Converse, 137 U. S. 624, 632; Compagnie Francaise &c. v. Board of Health, 186 U. S. 380, 393; Jacobson v. Massachusetts, 197 U. S. 11, 25-27.

Mr. John L. Jeffries and Mr. Jas. B. Catón for the appellant. Mr. J. Garland Pollard and Mr. Christopher B. Garnett for the appellee.
